title: Nonzero multiplication has finite kernel
statement: Let k be an algebraically closed field with decidable equality, of arbitrary characteristic, and let W be a Weierstrass curve over k with W.Δ ≠ 0. For every natural number n, if there exists Q : W.toAffine.Point with n • Q ≠ 0, then the subtype {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0} is finite, using the usual point-group operation and identity.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [DecidableEq k] (W : WeierstrassCurve k), W.Δ ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℕ, (∃ P : W.toAffine.Point, n • P ≠ 0) → Finite {P : W.toAffine.Point // n • P = 0}
